data.exact_reserve_text: The Syndicate saw modest favourable prior year development in 2022, improving the loss ratio by 0.2pps (2021: 1.6pps). Favourable experience from prior year major losses was largely offset by adverse non-catastrophe related development across a handful of classes.

prior_year_events.impact_description: COVID-19 related reserves at 31 December 2022 are materially unchanged from those at 31 December 2021.

named_events.loss_description: COVID-19 related reserves at 31 December 2022 are materially unchanged from those at 31 December 2021.
The Syndicate has direct exposures within the Terrorism, Casualty Treaty, Marine War, Contingency and Political and Credit Risk classes, along with secondary impacts across the Cyber class.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding were GBP 226.7m at 1 January 2022. The report describes modest favourable prior year development in 2022 (improving the loss ratio by c.0.2 percentage points), but the gross claims development triangle analysis shows a very small net adverse movement of GBP 0.1m across older underwriting years (2017-2020). The Managing Agent attributes movements to a combination of favourable experience from prior-year major losses offset by adverse non-catastrophe development, with inflation and economic uncertainty cited as inflationary pressures on claims costs.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development gross amount was not provided explicitly in a single 'movement in prior year provision' note. The prior_year_development_gbp_m was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (pages 46) following the prescribed diagonal method and excluding the two most recent underwriting years. The Managing Agent narrative describes a modest favourable prior year development (a net release), which is directionally different from the tiny net strengthening (+GBP 0.1m) derived from the triangle - this may be due to rounding, classification of years, or inclusion/exclusion of specific items in the narrative. No explicit gross prior-year movement line item was found.
